declaration.preface:
Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP is committed to respecting and upholding the fundamental human and labour rights of all individuals associated with its operations. We believe that fair treatment, safe working conditions, and respect for dignity are essential to sustainable business practices. Our approach to labour and human rights is guided by applicable national labour laws and internationally recognized standards.

This Labour & Human Rights Policy outlines our commitment to ethical employment practices, non-discrimination, workplace health and safety, and responsible engagement with employees, contractors, and business partners. Through this policy, we aim to foster a respectful, inclusive, and compliant work environment that supports employee well-being and long-term organizational sustainability.
declaration.declaration: Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP is committed to upholding fundamental human and labour rights across all its operations. We prohibit child labour, forced labour, discrimination, and unsafe working conditions, and ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws. The Company provides fair wages, safe workplaces, and equal opportunities for all employees. We also expect our suppliers and business partners to respect these principles.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, contractors, business partners, suppliers, and service providers of Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP across its operations. It covers all stages of employment, including recruitment, wages and benefits, working hours, career development, workplace conditions, occupational health and safety, and employee well-being. All parties are expected to uphold labour and human rights standards in line with the Company’s commitment to ethical and responsible business practices.

focusAreas: Child Labor, Forced Labor, and Human Trafficking

Employees’ Health and Safety: Foster a strong safety-first culture across all operations.
3.1.2 Continuously strengthen health and safety practices to proactively manage workplace risks and promote employee well-being, with the aim of minimizing work-related injuries and absenteeism.
Working Conditions: Promote ethical conduct, psychological safety, and employee well-being across the workplace.
Continuously improve workplace facilities, systems, and practices.
Social Dialogue: Encourage open and transparent communication through structured internal channels.
Hold periodic labor–management interactions with documented discussions and follow-up actions.
Support employee representation and participation in workplace matters in line with applicable laws.
Career Management and Training: Encourage continuous professional development through structured training and learning programs.
Promote fair and transparent career growth, performance evaluation, and advancement opportunities.
Child Labor, Forced Labor, and Human Tra: Prevent child labor, forced labor, discrimination, and unfair employment practices across operations.
Respect and protect the dignity, rights, and equal treatment of all employees and workers.
Conduct due diligence on suppliers and business partners regarding labour practices.
Discrimination and Harassment: Maintain a respectful and inclusive workplace with zero tolerance for discrimination, bias, or harassment.
Strengthen and continuously improve grievance redressal mechanisms to ensure fair, timely, and transparent resolution of concerns.
External Stakeholder Human Rights: Respect and promote human rights across the value chain, including suppliers, customers, contractors, and local communities.
Maintain open communication and grievance mechanisms to address stakeholder concerns transparently and build trust.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Promote fair opportunities for employment and career growth for all individuals.
Encourage equitable access to development and leadership opportunities.
Integrate diversity and inclusion principles into recruitment, development, and retention practices.
Work-Life Balance: Encourage a positive work culture that supports employee motivation, engagement, and work-life balance.
Promote employee wellness through stress management and support programs.
Ensure workloads are properly managed to maintain productivity and well-being.

policy.monitoring: Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP is committed to regularly monitoring its labor and human rights performance across key focus areas such as employee health and safety, working conditions, social dialogue, career management and training, prevention of child and forced labor, non-discrimination and harassment, and respect for external stakeholder human rights. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are established for each area and tracked through internal monitoring systems to evaluate progress against defined commitments. These KPIs are reviewed on a quarterly basis, and findings are consolidated into performance reports for senior management to guide strategic decisi	on-making. Annual assessments capture achievements, identify gaps, and recommend corrective measures, while relevant outcomes are shared with stakeholders to promote transparency and accountability. All monitoring and reporting practices adhere to applicable labor laws, international conventions, and industry best practices, ensuring reliability, accuracy, and credibility in disclosures.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will be reviewed once in every three years, or earlier if required by the Chief People Officer to assess its effectiveness and alignment with evolving labor standards, human rights commitments, and applicable legal requirements. Feedback from audits, employee input, and stakeholder consultations will be incorporated into updates. Necessary revisions will be made to strengthen labor and human rights practices and drive continuous improvement. Any significant changes or updates will be communicated to all employees and relevant stakeholders to ensure effective implementation.
